title: Cyberspace Explorer for VS Code
description: The extension's parts: its commands, the panel per workspace folder, the page builder that turns index.html into a webview page, and what they use in VS Code and on disk.

components.name: Commands
components.responsibility: Open, Open in Cyberspace (3D), Open in Cyberspace Explorer on a folder, Reload, and the openFile command the page's links run.

components.name: Panels
components.responsibility: One webview panel per workspace folder: lists its view files, renders the page, keeps the address it is at, reloads when a view file changes, sends a new theme, and comes back after a restart.

components.name: Page builder
components.responsibility: Turns index.html into the webview's page: a content security policy, a nonce on every script, and a first script that hands it the workspace, the theme and the address.

components.name: Cyberspace explorer page
components.responsibility: The explorer itself, reading the workspace through its workspace adapter.

components.name: VS Code
components.responsibility: The editor: webviews, the workspace's files and watchers, the colour theme and settings, and editors to open files in.

components.name: jsDelivr
components.responsibility: Serves the page's typefaces, dagre and three.js.

relationships.description: Opens or reveals the panel for a folder, at an address.
Builds the page for the folder's views and the theme.
Finds and watches view files, follows the colour theme, shows the webview.
Opens a file through a command link.
Loads the typefaces, dagre and three.js.
